title: Time and approvals: timesheets clients approve
description: Hours logged in seconds, approved by managers and clients, locked per period. The account manager hears when a project runs over budget.
teaser: Hours logged in seconds, approved by managers and clients, locked per period.
h1: Hours that are complete, approved and ready to invoice
lead: People log time against what they were planned on. Managers approve in bulk, clients approve from a link, and approved periods are locked. When hours run past the budget, the account manager hears it before the next invoice.

features.title: Log time in seconds
features.text: Each person logs hours against the projects they are planned on, from My Space, with a note when it helps.

screen.describes: Logging a day's hours in My Space

features.title: Approve, then lock
features.text: Managers approve a week in one go. Once a period is approved and locked, past hours can't change under the invoice.

features.title: Clients approve from a link
features.text: Send the client a link to review and approve the hours before you invoice them, so the invoice is never the first time they see them.

screen.describes: Client reviewing hours from a link

signals.text: Budgets are checked every day, so an overrun is a conversation, not a surprise.

items.title: Hours at 90% of budget: Packaging line commissioning
items.line: 360 of 400 h. Talk to the client before the next invoice.

items.title: Hours over budget: Packaging line commissioning
items.line: 460 of 400 h. Talk to the client before the next invoice.

items.value: Billable and non-billable, including pre-sales time on deals.
Open or locked, so approved hours stay as they were approved.
A secure link per period, no client account needed.
At 90% and 100% of a project's estimated hours, to the account manager and project manager.
